_comment: QUIT Agent config. All fields are optional — defaults apply when omitted. Keys starting with '_' are documentation only.

llm._comment: provider choices: anthropic, openai, deepseek, qwen, moonshot, glm, transformers, lmstudio, local-vllm

agents._comment: Per-agent generation limits. CLI --stop-after can stop after any WorkflowState.

search_budget._comment: Controls how many papers the planner asks the retrieval pipeline to screen and select. Injected into the planner prompt so the LLM writes consistent values into ResearchBrief.json.

build_budget._comment: Controls code/experiment/review iteration caps. Injected into the planner prompt.

retrieval._comment: Sources: local, arxiv, openreview. local_database_path is the user-managed PDF folder. External retrieved PDFs are saved under runs/<run_id>/<pdf_dir>/. Repo links are saved as RepoCards; relevant repos are cloned later after IDEA_EVAL passes.

read._comment: mode choices: local_text uses local PDF text extraction before LLM evidence extraction; direct_pdf tries a file-input capable API model first and falls back to local_text when unsupported.

run_budget._comment: Epoch bounds for ALL runs (real and smoke fallback). LLM chooses within [min, max]; values outside are clamped automatically. train_epochs/eval_epochs are full dataset passes, not gradient steps.

dataset._comment: Dataset acquisition settings. The system tries to download a real dataset max_download_attempts times before falling back to synthetic data (smoke run).

write._comment: Compiled main PDFs with fewer than expected_main_pages are direct WRITE failures. latex_timeout_seconds controls each LaTeX command invocation.

local_vllm._comment: Only used when llm.provider is local-vllm
